title: Systems Engineer
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
  
As a Systems Engineer-Cloud in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!
  
JOB PURPOSE
  
The Cloud Engineer independently provisions and manages cloud infrastructure, develops infrastructure as code, and implements security and networking controls. This mid-level position focuses on building reliable cloud environments, driving automation, and mentoring junior cloud engineers.
  
  
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Cloud Infrastructure & Automation
  
- Independently provision and manage cloud infrastructure and services
  
  
- Develop and maintain infrastructure as code to ensure repeatable, version-controlled deployments
  
  
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure provisioning and deployment
  
  
- Implement automation to reduce manual effort and improve deployment efficiency
  
  
- Contribute to cloud environment optimization and capacity planning
  
  
  
Security, Networking & Compliance
  
- Implement cloud security controls and compliance guardrails across environments
  
  
- Configure and maintain cloud networking including connectivity, routing, and access policies
  
  
- Support identity and access management implementations
  
  
- Participate in security reviews and vulnerability remediation
  
  
- Contribute to cloud cost monitoring and optimization efforts
  
  
  
Collaboration & Mentorship
  
- Mentor junior cloud engineers on tools, processes, and best practices
  
  
- Collaborate with Cloud Architects on translating designs into production infrastructure
  
  
- Participate in architectural reviews and contribute technical input
  
  
- Share knowledge through documentation updates and team discussions
  
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education
  
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field
  
  
- Equivalent experience (4+ years) may substitute for degree
  
  
  
Experience
  
- 6+ years of professional experience in cloud engineering or DevOps
  
  
- Proven track record of independently managing cloud infrastructure
  
  
- Experience implementing security controls and networking configurations
  
  
- Payments, financial services, or regulated industry experience preferred
  
  
  
Technical Skills
  
- Strong proficiency with cloud platform services and infrastructure
  
  
- Solid infrastructure as code skills for defining and managing cloud environments
  
  
- Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure
  
  
- Working knowledge of cloud security, IAM, and compliance practices
  
  
- Strong networking knowledge including connectivity, routing, and load balancing
  
  
- Proficient scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar)
  
  
- Understanding of cloud cost management and optimization techniques
  
  
  
Professional Skills
  
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  
  
- Excellent communication skills for technical collaboration
  
  
- Self-motivated with ability to work independently
  
  
- Collaborative team player with mentoring capabilities
  
  
  
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
- Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments
  
  
- Cloud platform certifications (associate or professional level)
  
  
- Familiarity with container orchestration and microservices infrastructure
  
  
- Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices
  
  
  
WORK ENVIRONMENT
  
- Hybrid work model (3 days in-office);
  
  
- Minimal travel required; occasional team meetings or training
  
  
- Standard business hours with occasional extended hours for deployments or incident.
  
  
  
Core Capabilities:
  
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:
  
- Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  
  
- Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
- Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
- Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
  
  
- Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  
  
- Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.
  
  
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
  
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com

* Interpret and validate engineering drawings, specifications, models, and design information.

**About Nexus**
You don't have an AI story if you don't have your data story. That's where NexusOne comes in.
  
  
We're the converged data platform for the AI era — composable by design, built on an open-source foundation, and AI-native from the ground up. One identity, one governance envelope, one operational layer across every mainframe, data lake, warehouse, and streaming system in the business. For the first time, enterprises can bring their existing stack along instead of rebuilding it — and still give AI agents full context across the estate.
  
  
What we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. No rip-and-replace. No multi-year transformation. Our CEO Anu Jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85+ open-source tools pre-integrated. AI-native automations that deploy and self-heal the stack without human toil. Forward-deployed engineers who build shoulder-to-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks.
  
  
It's working, and fast. We're tripling revenue year over year, backed by Insight Partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. Our platform processes credit risk data for 90%+ of US small businesses — 40M+ — every month. Intent signals for 300M+ subscribers monthly for Africa's largest telco. The data and AI layer for a Top 3 US bank.
  
  
We're 100+ people across the US and India, headquartered in Atlanta. We think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. We hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it.
  
  
Check out this podcast of Anu talking about our solution here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g8g50sv5GhQ
  
  
As we continue our journey, we are building a team of sharp, intelligent innovators who can move fast with great agility and passion. We are searching for an experienced
**IT Support & Systems Engineer**
to own both our IT systems and the day-to-day experience of the people who use them. Based in our Pune office and reporting to the Head of Information Technology in the US, you will be the hands-on owner of our devices, identities, and SaaS applications, and the first line of support for employees across NexusOne. You will work with the Security team to keep NexusOne productive, secure, and audit-ready. The ideal candidate takes end-to-end ownership, fixes problems at the root, documents what they do, and thrives working across time zones.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
**End-User Support & Service Desk**

* Own the IT support queue: triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets in our ticketing system (Linear), and route Slack requests into a single tracked intake
* Provide Level 1/Level 2 support for macOS, Windows, Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Meet), Zoom, VPN, SSO/MFA, and core SaaS applications, escalating complex issues to US IT, Security, or vendors with clear documentation
* Meet defined response and resolution targets, and report on support metrics (ticket volume, first response time, resolution time, user satisfaction)
* Identify recurring issues, drive them to root cause, and close the loop with affected users
* Provide responsive, white-glove support for executives, including travel and account lockout scenarios
* Build and maintain a user-facing and AI ingested knowledge base of how-tos, FAQs, and self-service guides that reduce ticket volume
* Provide support coverage with partial overlap with US business hours, and help with urgent after-hours issues as needed

**Asset & Endpoint Management**

* Own the full lifecycle of laptops and IT assets in Pune: procurement, imaging, assignment, repair, refresh, recovery, and secure disposal
* Maintain an accurate asset inventory, with assignments, warranties, and chain of custody tracked for audits
* Administer Rippling MDM: device enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment, OS/patch compliance, and remote lock/wipe
* Troubleshoot and resolve Rippling MDM issues (enrollment failures, policy conflicts, app deployment errors, non-compliant devices) and escalate to Rippling support when needed
* Support our partial transition to Apple devices, including Mac deployment, setup, and user onboarding to macOS

**Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Run device and access onboarding for new hires so laptops, accounts, and apps are ready on day one, including a first-day IT orientation
* Execute timely offboarding: access revocation, device recovery and wipe, and coordination of courier pickup/returns with vendors
* Partner with HR/People Ops on joiner, mover, and leaver workflows and keep evidence of completion

**Identity & Access Management**

* Administer user accounts, groups, and roles across Google Workspace, Rippling, and connected SaaS applications (including remaining Microsoft 365/Entra ID tenants)
* Apply least-privilege, role-based access; process access requests and support periodic access reviews
* Manage SSO/SAML application setup, MFA enforcement, and group-based provisioning
* Resolve account lockouts, MFA resets, and access issues quickly and securely

**License & SaaS Management**

* Track and optimize software licenses: assign, reclaim, and true-up seats, and flag unused spend
* Maintain the SaaS application inventory and support renewals and vendor evaluations

**Vendor & Office IT Operations**

* Manage local IT vendors in Pune (hardware suppliers, repair partners, ISPs, couriers), including quotes, POs, SLAs, and contract follow-ups
* Maintain office IT infrastructure: network, Wi-Fi, printers, meeting rooms, and AV

**Security & Compliance Collaboration**

* Work with the Security team on endpoint security (EDR, disk encryption, screen lock, patching), alert triage, and incident response
* Support with maintaining evidence for compliance programs (e.g., HITRUST, SOC 2) using Vanta, and remediate failing device and access controls
* Follow and help enforce IT and security policies, and educate staff on security best practices

**Coordination with US IT Leadership**

* Act as the on-site IT owner in Pune, reporting status, risks, and metrics to the Head of IT in the US
* Participate in cross-time-zone planning and prioritization, write runbooks and SOPs, and propose automation and process improvements that reduce manual work and ticket volume

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* 4–7 years of hands-on IT experience spanning both systems administration and end-user support, ideally in a fast-growing technology company or startup
* Proven service desk experience: owning a ticket queue, working to SLAs, and using a ticketing tool (Linear, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar)
* Strong Windows and macOS troubleshooting skills, plus experience supporting Google Workspace users
* Strong hands-on experience with MDM (Rippling MDM preferred) for Windows and macOS
* Administrator experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365/Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, SSO/SAML, and MFA
* Proven experience running device lifecycles, onboarding/offboarding, and license management at scale
* Experience managing local vendors and procurement in India
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewalls) and endpoint security tools
* Experience with remote support tools and supporting distributed users across time zones
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks and audit evidence collection (Vanta or similar is a plus)
* Scripting or automation skills (Bash, PowerShell, Python, Google Apps Script) are a plus

**Why You’ll Love Working at Nexus**
At Nexus, we value people who want to grow — and support each other while doing so.
  
  
You can expect:
  
  

* A collaborative team culture built on curiosity and respect
* Challenging work where your contributions clearly matter
* A leadership team that invests in learning and development
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud, data, and AI innovation

**Ready to Apply?**
If this role sounds like a great fit — or even
*close*
to one — we’d love to hear from you. We know that no candidate checks every single box, and we’re excited to meet people who bring curiosity, talent, and a desire to build meaningful work together.

**About The Role**
We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to help build and scale our Azure-native cloud platform as we migrate services from an on-premises data center to the cloud. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong mentoring component -- you will design and build alongside the team while raising the technical bar for engineers earlier in their careers. You will work across infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, and security tooling, with exposure to both legacy automation modernization and net-new platform capability.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role. You will not have direct reports, but you will be expected to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the team, including reviewing designs, pairing on complex problems, and setting technical direction by example.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design and build Azure infrastructure using a cloud native approach, leveraging managed services wherever they meet reliability and cost requirements.
* Lead technical execution of the migration of services from an on-premises data center to Azure, including dependency mapping, migration sequencing, and cutover risk management.
* Operate and extend our AKS-based platform, including GitOps deployment patterns, namespace isolation, and policy enforcement.
* Own and evolve reusable Terraform modules that other engineering teams consume, with clear interface contracts between platform-owned and application-owned infrastructure.
* Build and maintain observability coverage (metrics, logs, alerting) so that platform and application health are measurable and actionable, not just instrumented.
* Apply policy-as-code to enforce security, compliance, and operational standards across the platform, and reduce reliance on manual review gates.
* Design and review Identity and Access Management patterns, including workload identity, least-privilege access models, and secrets management -- with a clear bias away from static credentials.
* Participate in business continuity and disaster recovery planning for platform services, including failover design, RTO/RPO definition, and recovery testing.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and standards used across engineering teams building on the platform.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of the standard workflow, and evaluate where AI-driven platform capabilities (automated remediation, intelligent alerting, natural-language operational tooling) can be responsibly introduced into the platform itself.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code/design review, pairing, and informal technical coaching. Help less experienced engineers build sound judgment around idempotency, error handling, and migration candidacy when evaluating legacy automation.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, with demonstrated Principal-level scope (technical leadership without formal management).
* Deep hands-on experience with Azure, building cloud native architectures using managed services rather than defaulting to IaaS.
* Production experience running and operating Kubernetes at scale, ideally AKS specifically.
* Strong GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to a data center-to-cloud migration, including business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent) for security and compliance enforcement.
* Strong Identity and Access Management background: workload identity federation, least-privilege IAM design, secrets management patterns that avoid static credentials.
* Experience building and maintaining an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).
* Solid Terraform experience, including designing reusable modules consumed by other teams, not just single-project usage.
* Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers -- through review, pairing, or informal technical leadership -- without formal authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing or operating hub-and-spoke network architectures in Azure.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design for multi-team, multi-repo environments (e.g., GitHub Actions-based runner infrastructure).
* Exposure to evaluating or building genuinely AI-driven operational tooling (as distinct from rules-based automation mislabeled as AI).
* Experience presenting technical tradeoffs to both engineering and business stakeholders.

description:
**Who We Are**

Gamma Technologies (GT), the global leader in multi-physics system simulation software, develops a suite of integrated solutions designed to guide and accelerate the engineering transformation of today’s products. Fusing advanced physics with AI algorithms, our platform, GT-SUITE, is used to simulate a broad range of systems from early stage development to digital twin applications across multiple industries including transportation and mobility, marine, aerospace and defense, power and energy, data centers and HVACR.

At Gamma Technologies, our people are the driving force behind our success. We are looking for Business Systems Engineer who shares our passion for authentic innovation, trusted partnerships, bold decisions and a relentless focus on customer success.

**What You Will Do**

At Gamma Technologies, the right systems keep our technical and business teams moving. As GT grows and our needs become more complex, you will make sure the right solutions are delivered, maintained, and continuously improved.

In this role, you will:

* Administer and develop solutions within our business systems, including our CRM (Salesforce) and LMS (Docebo)
* Support our marketing automation (HubSpot), ERP (NetSuite), and other business platforms
* Work with our technical systems, including development task management (ClickUp) and revision control (Perforce and Git)
* Help evaluate and onboard new systems as our needs evolve
* Develop and maintain integrations between our systems, a critical part of this role
* Partner with business users to deliver, maintain, and continuously improve the solutions they rely on

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in the Information Technology/Systems field
* Hands-on Salesforce configuration experience: Flow, permission sets, custom objects and fields, reports and dashboards, SOQL, Data Loader, and deployment through sandboxes
* Hands-on LMS administration experience: content and course management, reports and dashboards, user and group management, workflow automation
* Experience administering at least one other business system end to end
* Experience building and maintaining integrations between business systems using APIs, webhooks, and/or middleware (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Zapier, or custom code)
* Ability to work directly with non-technical business users and translate their needs into working solutions
* Working knowledge of compliance and information security practices as they apply to business systems: least-privilege access, segregation of duties, and supporting access reviews and audit evidence requests
* Ability and willingness to work from 3:00 PM to 11:59 PM IST to collaborate with global teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified LMS administrator
* Salesforce Certified Administrator (Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder a plus)
* Experience with Apex and Lightning Web Components
* Experience administering ERP, marketing, legal ticketing, and/or task management platforms
* Familiarity with revision control systems (e.g., Git, Perforce)
* Familiarity with SSO (SAML/OIDC) configuration for business applications

**What We Can Offer You**

* A dynamic and highly talented team of experts
* The opportunity to bring in your own ideas, implement them, and make them accessible to a large customer base
* A primary work location at our Pune, India office, with a hybrid work policy asking employees to report to the office 3 days per work week
* An attractive salary and additional company benefits

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer, dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace for all.

title: Associate Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented
**Associate Systems Support Engineer**
to join our IT operations team. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring and maintaining the performance of critical systems, ensuring the uptime and availability of applications and infrastructure. This role involves working with monitoring tools such as AppDynamics (AppD), LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor, as well as monitoring SQL databases, Windows servers, and Internet Information Services (IIS). The Associate Systems Support Engineer will provide L1 and L2 support while ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor the performance and availability of applications and infrastructure using tools such as AppDynamics, LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor.
* Conduct regular health checks and performance tuning of SQL databases to ensure optimal operation.
* Oversee the functionality and performance of Windows servers and IIS, applying necessary configurations and updates as needed.
* Monitor interface subsystems to ensure seamless data flow and connectivity between systems.
* Provide first-level support for system incidents, diagnosing issues and escalating problems to higher-level engineering teams when necessary.
* Maintain documentation related to system configurations, procedures, and incident responses.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents to prevent future occurrences and improve system reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and configurations while minimizing downtime.
* Ensure 24/7 uptime of critical systems, responding quickly to alerts and incidents to meet predefined SLAs.
* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to recommend improvements to monitoring processes and tools.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience in a systems monitoring and support role.
* Familiarity with application performance monitoring tools such as AppDynamics, LogicMonitor, and Azure Monitor.
* Basic knowledge of SQL databases, including monitoring and troubleshooting techniques.
* Understanding of Windows Server administration and IIS management.
* Experience with monitoring server uptime, performance metrics, and alert management.
* Proficient in troubleshooting system issues and performing root cause analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail to ensure high-quality service delivery.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Availability to work in a 24x7 environment (9 Hours or 12 Hours shift), including evenings, weekends, and on-call rotations as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of monitoring tools like AppDynamics and LogicMonitor.
* Understanding of healthcare application is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of ITIL best practices and frameworks.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Middleware Platform, Azure, Microsoft Windows Server, Monitoring, Automation and AI
  
  
Location: Remote — Pune or Baroda
  
  
Experience: 4–6 years
  
  
Shift: 24×7 rotation, including planned maintenance windows and change events
  
  
**Role Summary**

* You will keep our Middleware Platform, Azure and Windows server estate running day to day — responding to alerts, resolving incidents within SLA, Product/Application deployment, executing changes cleanly, and steadily improving the stability of the systems in your care.
* You work within established processes and alongside Team Engineers and Database Administrators, taking ownership of your own queue and escalating appropriately.
* This role also carries a real automation mandate. We expect you to notice repetitive manual work and remove it — through scripting, through Azure automation tooling, and increasingly through AI agents that handle routine operational tasks.

**Experience**

* 4–6 years in systems administration, Application and infrastructure support or cloud operations.
* Minimum 4 years hands-on production Azure administration (not lab, training or certification-only exposure).
* Minimum 3 years administering Windows Server in production.
* Experience working to SLAs in a ticket-driven support environment.
* Willing and available to work rotating 24×7 shifts and out-of-hours maintenance windows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduation or Above
* Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Azure platform administration
* Administer Azure infrastructure day to day; provision, resize and decommission Azure resources following documented standards and approved change requests.
* Support Azure PaaS workloads including App Services — deployments, configuration, scaling and restarts.
* Apply resource tagging, cost-optimisation recommendations and policy compliance actions as directed.
* Alert monitoring and response
* Own the alert queue on your shift. Monitor Logic Monitor, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and the enterprise monitoring platform; acknowledge, triage and action alerts within SLA.
* Investigate alerts using KQL queries in Log Analytics, Application Insights telemetry and Windows Event Logs.
* Identify duplicate or non-actionable alerts and propose tuning — threshold changes, aggregation windows, suppression rules. Flagging a bad alert is part of the job, not an optional extra.
* Maintain monitoring coverage and visibility: report agents that are down or resources missing from monitoring, and build/maintain dashboards and workbooks that surface system health to the team.
* System stabilisation
* Resolve incidents end to end; support the Team Members during major incidents with diagnostics, evidence gathering and communication updates.
* Contribute to root cause analysis — collect logs and timelines, document findings, and implement the corrective actions assigned to you.
* Perform proactive health checks across applications, servers and Azure resources: disk, CPU, memory, service state, certificate expiry, backup success.
* Build knowledge of application architecture, help create and update application and alert-handling documentation, and perform pre/post product functionality checks.
* Track recurring issues in your queue and raise them as problem records rather than repeatedly applying the same workaround.
* Perform performance troubleshooting using standard OS and Azure diagnostic tools.
* AI agent development and process automation
* Write and maintain PowerShell scripts for routine administration: user and resource provisioning, health checks, reporting, scheduled tasks and cleanup jobs.
* Optional: Build automation using Azure Automation Runbooks, Logic Apps and Power Automate, with proper authentication via managed identity and alerting on failure.
* Contribute to building AI agents that support operations — log summarisation, alert triage and classification, drafting incident notes, and answering questions from our runbook and knowledge base.
* Apply prompt engineering to generate scripts, configurations and documentation, and verify AI output before it reaches production — you are accountable for what you deploy, regardless of what produced it.
* Follow responsible-AI practice without exception.
* Windows and application support
* Administer Windows Server in Azure and hybrid environments
* Support IIS — application pool management, bindings, virtual directories, logs and basic performance troubleshooting.
* Perform SSL/TLS certificate tasks: renewal, installation, binding, store management and expiry monitoring.
* Support high-availability configurations including Windows Failover Clustering and SQL Server Always On, working with the team engineers and the database administrators.
* Process and collaboration
* Work within ITIL incident, problem and change management using ServiceNow; raise and document change requests accurately and complete them within approved windows.
* Maintain and improve runbooks, SOPs and knowledge articles — especially after resolving something the documentation didn't cover.
* Provide clear, timely shift handovers and status updates to stakeholders during incidents.

**Communication**

* Clear written and spoken English; able to write an incident update a non-technical stakeholder can follow.
* Reliable, organised, and comfortable asking for help early rather than late.

**Technical**

* Azure PaaS and IaaS administration, Windows Server administration, IIS administration and SSL certificate handling.
* Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, with working ability to read and write basic KQL.
* PowerShell scripting — able to write and modify scripts independently, not only run existing ones.
* Ticketing and ITIL process discipline.
* Practical use of AI/LLM tools in a work context, with at least one concrete example of manual work you've automated or removed.

Certifications
  
  

* Required: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) — held, not "training completed".
* Preferred: AZ-900, AI-900, ITIL Foundation, MCSA or equivalent Windows Server certification.

Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Embedded Proxy \& Appliance

**About Securly** 




 Securly is a K\-12 EdTech company built around one mission: keeping students safe and well, both online and off. Our platform gives schools the infrastructure to filter and monitor web traffic, flag signs of self\-harm or bullying, and support student wellness — all while giving IT teams tools that hold up on real school networks, not just in a demo. That mission runs straight through this role: the edge proxy appliance is core infrastructure sitting inside thousands of school networks, and it has to work every single school day, at scale, without fail.
 



 We're a team of roughly 330 people across Pune, the US, and the UK, working across engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams to build and support that platform. Engineering in Pune plays a central role in building the systems that make Securly's safety mission possible — this isn't a satellite team, it's where core infrastructure like this gets built.
 



**The Role** 




 If you've spent your career close to the hardware — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, bring\-up on constrained systems — and you're deep in production Rust, this is a chance to own the embedded proxy software running on a fleet of appliances deployed across thousands of school networks, from the OS layer up through the AWS control plane managing it all.
 



**Must\-Haves:** 



* Embedded Linux fundamentals — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, or hardware bring\-up
* 3\+ years hands\-on production Rust in a systems or embedded context (not app/web Rust)
* 6\+ years total engineering experience
* Systems/network programming — TCP stream handling, socket programming, transparent proxying
* Docker/containerization for constrained/appliance deployment
* Performance testing and profiling — load testing, memory/CPU profiling, flame graph analysis
* Working knowledge of AWS and IaC concepts



**Strongly Preferred:** 
 Named fleet/IoT/embedded device product on your resume, C/C\+\+ or Go alongside Rust, eBPF/netfilter/HAProxy/Envoy exposure
 



**Nice to Have:** 
 RADIUS, observability (CloudWatch/Splunk/SLOs)
